stem: According to the summary of adult outcomes, what percentage of children with ADHD will continue to experience symptoms into adolescence?
explanation: 60% to 80% of children with ADHD continue to experience symptoms into adolescence.
rationale: A large majority, though not all, continue to have symptoms beyond childhood.

optionExplanations.A: Correct because the summary indicates that a large majority of children with ADHD continue to have symptoms into adolescence.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because this range is too low for the proportion of children who continue to be affected.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because not all children continue to have symptoms into adolescence.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because only a very small minority would fall below this level, which does not match the summary.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because this is lower than the reported proportion that continue to experience symptoms.

source.hint: A large majority, though not all, continue to have symptoms beyond childhood.
